title: Provincial Assembly of The Punjab Privileges Second Amendment Act 2012

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Assembly of The Punjab Privileges Second Amendment Act 2012
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXI OF 2012
ACT XXXI OF 2012
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB
PRIVILEGES (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012
An Act further to amend the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab Privileges Act, 1972 (II of 1972)
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary
8th March, 2012]
No.PAP-Legis-3(17)/2009/555,
dated 8-3-2012---The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Second
Amendment) Bill 2009, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on 28th February 2012, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on
7th March 2012, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient further to amend the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges
Act, 1972 (II of 1972), in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as
follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
Privileges (Second Amendment) Act, 2012.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.
